investigations.summary: GSSAPI OL8 PSMDB Replica 6.x/7.x/8.x: PMM-T2843 and PMM-T2832 (new in #1800) kill pbm-agent with 'systemctl kill --kill-whom=main', and OL8's systemd 239 rejects it ('unrecognized option'); the option was renamed only in systemd 252, so OL9 lanes pass. Reproduced on a CHAOS VM on OL8 (main failed 2/2 with CI's error); --kill-who passed 2/2 on OL8 and on OL9 (systemd 252).

CLI PSMDB Replica 6.x/7.x: PMM-T2837's beforeAll takeBackup waited 5 min on a backup PBM reported 'not found': the resync helper returns on the earlier resync's log line, so pbm backup is sent while the forced resync still holds PBM's lock. Already fixed by the open pmm-qa#1831 (reproduced on a CHAOS VM there); no new cause.
